tex_content.html:
Under the hypotheses of Lemma 4, for every $A<\infty $ and $\delta ''>0$, the rescaled flow on $B(p_n,0,A)\times [0,\theta _n)$ is $\delta ''$-close in $C^{[1/\delta '']}$ to the standard flow for all sufficiently large $n$.
Proof

\sketch ↗ thm:shi-with-initial-derivatives Smooth convergence holds on every $[0,\theta -\eta ']$. Uniform curvature and derivative bounds on the remaining short interval, followed by $\eta '\downarrow 0$, give the stated closeness.

□
